components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When provided it must be unique across owners.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current date when not supplied on creation.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's display name, formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.

## Summary

Implemented the `sharesHousehold` flag on owner creation. When creating an owner, it's set to `true` if another owner already had the same address and city at that moment, otherwise `false` — creation is always allowed.

Because the acceptance test reads the flag back via `GET /api/owners/{id}` (and asserts the *first* owner at an address stays `false` even after a second one joins), the value is a **snapshot persisted at creation time**, mirroring the existing `namesakeCount` pattern rather than being recomputed on read.

Changes:
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `Owner` schema (regenerates into `OwnerDto`; MapStruct maps it by name).
- **`Owner.java`** — new `Boolean sharesHousehold` field (`shares_household` column) with getter/setter.
- **`AssignSharesHousehold.java`** (new function) — checks existing owners for a matching address + city and sets the flag. Runs before the new owner is saved, so it never matches itself.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step in after `assignNamesakeCount`, before `save`, under the same `transaction` governance. Placed after `normalizeCity` so it compares against the canonical city spelling.
- **schema.sql** (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres) — added the `shares_household` column; updated the hsqldb seed `data.sql` positional inserts with the extra value (the active test profile). h2/postgres use column-list inserts (unaffected); mysql's seed was already positionally out of sync pre-existing and is unused by tests.
